name: FITC single-positive
notes: Bright in FITC only. "Bright in ONE channel" is authored as a positive clause PLUS a negative clause for the other channel -- that is what makes "only that channel" unambiguous.
_note: EXAMPLE. The signature rule is AUTHORED metadata only -- nothing evaluates it against an image yet (v7.9 decision D3). No thresholds are set, so the level is left to the future evaluator.
